_note: Every member on Congress Receipts. path = folder and URL (congressreceipts.org/<path>/). format: 'shared' members use site/ and scripts/ (published by scripts/publish.py); 'legacy' members keep their own pages and scripts until converted. chamber and voteId (House: bioguide; Senate: LIS id) feed the hub. eventsResearched: false until town halls and events have been collected. live: false keeps a member out of every build and publish (pages, attendance, leaders, directory) until their tracker has passed run_checks; omit it (or true) for a finished tracker. hub: false keeps a published tracker off the hub pages (attendance, leaders, directory) while its own pages are live; remove it when the tracker is finished.
